corporation_name.rationale: Corporation name is a header field not present in the Schedule L canonical element list.

ein.rationale: EIN is a header field not present in the Schedule L canonical element list.

tax_year_begin.rationale: Tax year begin date is a header field not present in the Schedule L canonical element list.

tax_year_end.rationale: Tax year end date is a header field not present in the Schedule L canonical element list.

total_assets.rationale: Item F total assets from page 1 entity info area is not a distinct Schedule L canonical element (it derives from line 15 EOY but is stored on the main form, not in this schema).
